req.title: Task title accepts unicode
req.statement: The system shall accept task titles containing UTF-8 characters and return them intact.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-031 requires that POST /tasks/ accepts UTF-8 unicode in the title field and returns it intact. The violation was test[3] (test_unicode_title_boundary_101_codepoints_rejected) having kind=negative but heuristic=BVA. The rule requires that negative tests use heuristic=NEG, not BVA. Fix: change heuristic from BVA to NEG for that test. All other tests are preserved exactly as they were. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — a typical multi-script unicode title is stored and echoed verbatim; (2) boundary BVA — a unicode title at exactly max_length=100 codepoints; (3) boundary BVA — 99 codepoints (max-1); (4) negative NEG — 101 codepoints (max+1) must be rejected with 422; (5) negative NEG — empty string rejected with 422; (6) positive EP — emoji and RTL roundtrip.

tests.name: test_unicode_title_positive_multiscript
preconditions: Database is initialised with pre-loaded rows
actions: POST /tasks/ with a title containing CJK, Arabic, emoji, and Latin unicode characters
expected: Response JSON title field equals the submitted unicode string verbatim
trace: R-TASK-031: system shall accept UTF-8 titles and return them intact
tests.executable:
import os, sys
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite://')
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import engine
from app import models
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
client = TestClient(app)
unicode_title = u'\u4e2d\u6587 \u0639\u0631\u0628\u064a \U0001f600 caf\u00e9'
payload = {'title': unicode_title, 'description': None, 'completed': False}
r = client.post('/tasks/', json=payload)
assert r.status_code == 201
body = r.json()
assert body['title'] == unicode_title
assert isinstance(body['id'], int)
assert body['completed'] == False
